This strange grassland flower changes colour depending on the light, and was once used in medicines and dyes.
A large seed found in meadows and grasslands. Very little is known about them, but they shimmer softly in sunlight.
Little is known of the ancients, but it’s believed they possessed technology far in advance of our own. Hopefully, my research into the ruins will shed some light on the mystery.
Found what looks like the remains of a killing machine, but the head displays unusual colourisation and appears to be detachable. Could this be a relic of the ancients?
The ruins contain an enormous artefact. From its appearance, I surmise it is some form of matter transference device. There is a depression nearby, but its function remains unclear.
Confirmed that defeating an alpha stops monsters exiting a rift. However, defeated alphas reappear over time. Recommend periodic elimination operations to maintain rift security.
A sturdy and durable bag sold in Lunia. It holds more than you'd expect, and Roly is very taken with it.

The wind caresses waves of green,
The sky extends with radiant gleam.
Light descends, the earth serene,
Forever onward flows time's stream.
It might just look like a plain old stick to you, but in the hands of a child, it transforms into the mighty Sword of Legend! ‘It's my turn to be the hero. And Nina's the princess!’
Nina dropped this fine, embroidered handkerchief when she was captured by monsters. No mere commoner would possess an item of such quality and workmanship.
A bunch of flowers stolen from a human and given to Nina as a present. The attached card reads, ‘My dearest Yumie, I love you with all my heart! Will you marry me?’
A precious stone excavated from caves near Solardor. It sparkles like a rainbow when light is shone upon it, and is rumoured to bring good luck to the wearer.
Found deep within caves, this fine sand twinkles like the stars at night. Its presence may indicate something special.
A faintly glowing stone found deep within a cave. Apply ample elbow grease and it buffs up to a fine shine, making it a lovely decoration for any room.
Discovered a stone imbued with magic at the back of a cave. It seems the ancients used the arcane arts to power their devices. Perhaps this stone is one such energy source?
This pickaxe, found abandoned in a cave, appears to have belonged to a miner from Solardor. You might be able to use it to hack open a new path, but it may break if overused.
Grants one-time entry to Karnaccus's famous Puff-Puffery. Bonnie's smooth skin is proof the Puff-Puffery will soothe your spirit and revitalize your vim!
This boulder was cloven in two by the captain of the Dragon Wings in a fight with an alpha, demonstrating his prodigious skill with the sword.
A beautiful bloom said to increase the intelligence of any who bear it. They grow near oases, but are feared by desert dwellers, who say the flowers suck up the precious water.
A mysterious flower that blooms only at night. It emits a silvery glow when bathed in starlight, and is said to heal weary desert travellers.
A shard of dragon bone. Given the size, it probably came from a dragon at least ten times the size of a king slime.
Dried leaves used for brewing tea. Their uniquely refreshing aroma is most appealing, and a single cup should be enough to relieve any fatigue.
It is said that the ancients stored their collected wisdom in a great museum. Finding such a treasure trove would allow me to make a dramatic leap forward in my research.
It's hard to believe a mere merchant such as I can fulfil the august role of Sheik. Yet I must do my utmost to help this community prosper and bring happiness to the people.
Apparently, there's a town deep in the forest surrounded by water that is so beautiful, you'll never want to leave. It's a long way, though, so I'd best pack plenty of supplies.
After many days in the woods, I've finally arrived at the town the locals call ‘Sylvald’. However, the town is covered with a dense fog that obscures its beauty. Is something amiss?
Ten days since I arrived in Sylvald. Rumours abound that monsters are impersonating humans, and people are starting to suspect that I'm one of them. I must leave tomorrow...
A wooden Roly carved by a Sylvaldian artisan to express the town's gratitude for the help they received. Word has it, they are the next big thing!
This Sylvaldian speciality is made from local grapes and fresh forest water. According to Quin, it boasts exceptional aroma and flavour.
Goopy is particularly fond of these extremely sweet grapes that grow in the forest around Sylvald. Eating them has no effect on your stats, though.
A token made by the people of Sylvald as a reminder to never allow mutual suspicion to arise again. May the people's trust in each other grow as strong as their sacred tree.
I took up the sword to protect my family and my country, but the monsters took them both. What am I still fighting for?
This fine rock salt is the number one souvenir for visitors to Moneta. A single sprinkle is enough to transform the blandest dish into a gourmand's delight.

In world of blue, so crystal clear, 
Storm's memories do disappear.
In beauty vast, time quietly fades,
Leaves only calm, where peace pervades.
This colourful shell recovered its glow when the demonic presence was banished from the seas. Place it to your ear to hear the soothing sound of waves.
After defeating the alpha, he just sat by me in the inn, drinking in silenzio. Rather than being pleased, he had a look of grim determination on his face.
A magical candle with an eternal flame. The innkeeper quietly left it for two sisters with endless stories to share.
A piece of coral with deep scratch marks where the alpha, driven from its home, furiously sharpened its claws in preparation to tear the invaders apart.
Reunited after a long time apart, two sisters savoured this bolstering broth that warmed their hearts as much as their bodies.
A meticulously crafted model ship in a glass bottle depicting the crew who saved the docks.
A wooden sword the young Zepha used to practice with. The countless nicks and scratches speak eloquently of how hard she trained.
A figure used for strategic planning, worn smooth with use. Sigrid burnt the candle at both ends searching for a way to counter overwhelming strength with cunning and guile.
A cape made from thick travelling cloth that the children of the camp wear in their make-believe games. Their innocent play brings joy to their elders.
It is as if time has stood still since that fateful day. But there are those who carry the legacy of the fallen, and even now are striving to move on.
A single flower blooming among the soot-stained rubble. Once, the proud Vernan flowers filled the palace gardens. The castle may have fallen, but the spirit will never wither.
Forty years ago, the castle fell into ruin in the war against the Dragonlord. A flag bearing the faded coat of arms of its lost lord still flies from the ancient walls.
The queen used this silver comb to gently brush her young daughters' hair every morning. It is still warmed by a mother's love.
Some monsters appear native to their rifts, while others come from elsewhere. Further investigation is required to ascertain where these other monsters originate.
